high_potential_items.summary: On-screen aware AI assistant for your desktop. Uses current app context, multiple LLMs, and MCP tools to help you act across apps.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 读当前屏幕上下文，跨应用把事做完
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 做垂直场景助手时，可借鉴它把「当前屏幕内容」当成免输入的隐式上下文，再用 MCP 工具链把模型输出直接落到别的应用里，而不是停在对话框里。

high_potential_items.title: browser-act/skills
high_potential_items.name: skills
high_potential_items.summary: Browser automation CLI built for AI agents. Break through anti-bot walls, hand off to humans across platforms when stuck. Parallel multi-task execution, independent multi-session operation, isolated multi-account browsing.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 反爬穿透、卡住可转人工的多账号浏览器 CLI
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把浏览器自动化封装成 agent 可直接调用的 CLI，并在反爬拦截、验证码等卡点处保留人工接管入口，这套「自动跑为主、人工只接手卡点」的分工方式值得做网页抓取与数据提取的 agent 产品借鉴。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版先让一个 agent 会话通过 CLI 打开目标网站并抓取数据，识别到反爬或验证失败时暂停并把当前页面交给人工操作，人工处理完由同一会话继续往下跑。
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 为 AI Agent 提供浏览器自动化与反爬、人机交接能力，偏底层工具，可支撑企业自动化但非直接产品方向。

high_potential_items.title: callstack/agent-device
high_potential_items.name: agent-device
high_potential_items.summary: Mobile app automation and verification for AI coding agents. CLI, MCP server, and typed Node.js API for iOS, Android, HarmonyOS, TV, web, macOS, and Linux.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 让 AI 编码代理亲手操作移动端做验证
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 值得借鉴的是把 CLI、MCP server 和类型化 Node.js API 打包成同一套设备操作层，让 AI 代理像调用函数一样启动模拟器、装包、点按并断言界面，这个接入形态可迁移到任何需要代理触碰真实设备或浏览器的验证场景。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版只打通一条链路：用 MCP server 暴露启动 iOS 模拟器、安装应用、点按输入、截图断言四类工具，让代理独立跑通一次登录 E2E 并回传失败截图。
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 面向 AI 编程代理的移动端自动化验证工具，属于 Agent 基础设施，但与雷达关注的直接应用场景匹配度一般。

items.title: Sai
items.name: Sai
items.summary: The autonomous computer fleet at your command
items.description: Sai is the world's first robosecretary that works with a fleet of autonomous computers, doing your endless screen work. Each computer navigates software the way you do: reads the screen, clicks the button, types in the form. Trained to interact with the computer interface, Sai automates software even when they lack APIs: legacy desktop apps, internal portals, anything behind a login. Sai supports Windows, macOS and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Ang and I build Sai at Simular.

Sai is the world's first robosecretary that comes together with a fleet of autonomous computers doing your endless screen work. We believe the future of work isn't just one computer — it's many computer.

Each computer navigates software the way you do: reads the screen, clicks the button, types in the form. That's the whole point. Because Sai works at the interface layer, it automates things that have no API and never will — legacy desktop apps, internal portals, anything behind a login. Windows, macOS, and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.

What that buys you in practice:

🖥️ Real computers, not a chat box. You hand over a task, it runs it on an actual desktop. Open the workspace any time to watch, or take the mouse back mid-run.

🔁 It learns the route once. Any finished task can be saved as a skill, scheduled, or triggered by an event — so the tenth run is faster and cheaper than the first.

🔒 Autonomy with a seatbelt. Tiered approvals, "trust for this task," and encrypted input for passwords and codes — the model never sees plaintext.

The agent we actually optimize for is whether it's still useful and affordable the tenth time you ask.

Tell us the screen work that eats your week — we'll tell you honestly whether Sai can take it off your hands.

Congrats on the launch, Simular team!

How do you guys ensure that all runs are deterministic while still having this "thinking" part when, let's say, the form changes and we have to enter another value? Thinking from a perspective where I have to fill out hundreds of website forms almost daily, but those forms are updated monthly.
@Simular @agidude Congrats one the PH launch ! , Does it have human in loop control / fully autonomous ?

items.title: Mantra Timer
items.name: Mantra Timer
items.summary: A minimalist mantra meditation timer for iOS.
items.description: Mantra Meditation Timer rejects the bloated tracking of modern wellness apps. Built for self-directed practitioners, this elegant iOS app offers a distraction-free experience with zero data collection. Enjoy core Meditation timers, calming chimes, and mental or physical check-ins completely free. For established pro mantra practitioners, a small one-off payment unlocks advanced stats and deeper customisation. No subscription fatigue, just a beautifully simple tool for profound daily practice.
top_comments:
The Inspiration & Problem:

I have been practising Transcendental Meditation daily for over 3,700 consecutive days. After over a decade of practice I simply wanted a clean tool to support my daily practice. Instead, I found a wellness market saturated with bloated apps. The official options required intrusive personal background data, others pushed endless guided programmes, and almost all of them demanded a recurring monthly subscription just to sit in silence.

Mantra Timer was born out of pure frustration. I wanted to build a beautiful, distraction-free timer that treats practitioners with respect—meaning zero data collection and zero notifications shouting for your attention.

How the Product Evolved:

Building a software studio at a slower, "human pace" while managing a chronic illness (ME) forces you to become hyper-intentional.

Ditching the Subscription: I originally planned a standard annual subscription tier. But as the studio's anti-rental philosophy solidified, that felt hypocritical. So I completely changed direction. The core app is entirely free, and additional functionality for established practitioners is unlocked via a single, small one-off payment. Buy it once, own it forever.

I will be hanging out in the comments section and I would love to hear your feedback, your critiques, or your own stories about fighting subscription fatigue!
Totally love it! Can it work on my Apple Watch?
Sounds calm , what's the revenue model?

items.title: Morsa Signals
items.name: Morsa Signals
items.summary: GTM and AI visibility workflows for developer tools
items.description: Morsa Signals gives developer-tool founders and GTM teams practical GTM and SEO/GEO workflows in one place. Find relevant developers for scaled outreach, identify potential first users and early adopters, audit how AI search systems understand your site, and get a first read on competitors worth tracking. Each workflow starts from your actual product and produces a focused, actionable result instead of a generic report or database.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I’m Sergei, co-founder at Morsa.


We built Morsa Signals around a recurring problem with developer tools: strong products often struggle to reach the right developers, explain their relevance, and become discoverable through search and AI systems.

Morsa Signals brings together four focused workflows:


🔎 Contact Search
Finds relevant developers for teams scaling outreach, explains why each person fits, and suggests a personalized opening angle.
https://signals.morsa.io/contact-search


🌱 First Users
Helps solo and early-stage devtool founders identify potential early adopters for their first outreach conversations.
https://signals.morsa.io/first-users


🤖 AI Visibility Audit
Reviews how clearly a devtool website communicates its product to search and AI systems, then generates a ready-to-use prompt for addressing identified gaps.
https://signals.morsa.io/audit


📡 Competitor Tracking
Provides a first read on relevant competitors and the public signals worth monitoring.
https://signals.morsa.io/competitor-tracking


Each workflow starts with the actual product, audience, and problem. The goal is a focused, actionable result rather than a generic report or database.


I’d especially value feedback from devtool founders and GTM teams: which problem is most urgent for you, and what would make you trust the result?
Cool idea. I see you are relying on GitHub data to find relevant developers. You could expand your list by including profiles from launch platforms like Product Hunt, Peerlist and Indie Hackers.

One additional thought behind Morsa Signals:

Growing a developer tool rarely comes down to one isolated problem. Some teams need their first users, others need better outreach data, clearer AI visibility, or a better understanding of their competitive space.

We brought these workflows together because they all start from the same context: the actual product, its audience, and the problem it solves.

If you’re building a developer tool, I’d be interested to know which workflow you would use first and what you would need to trust its results.

items.title: Mantra Timer
items.name: Mantra Timer
items.summary: A minimalist mantra meditation timer for iOS.
items.description: Mantra Meditation Timer rejects the bloated tracking of modern wellness apps. Built for self-directed practitioners, this elegant iOS app offers a distraction-free experience with zero data collection. Enjoy core Meditation timers, calming chimes, and mental or physical check-ins completely free. For established pro mantra practitioners, a small one-off payment unlocks advanced stats and deeper customisation. No subscription fatigue, just a beautifully simple tool for profound daily practice.
top_comments:
The Inspiration & Problem:

I have been practising Transcendental Meditation daily for over 3,700 consecutive days. After over a decade of practice I simply wanted a clean tool to support my daily practice. Instead, I found a wellness market saturated with bloated apps. The official options required intrusive personal background data, others pushed endless guided programmes, and almost all of them demanded a recurring monthly subscription just to sit in silence.

Mantra Timer was born out of pure frustration. I wanted to build a beautiful, distraction-free timer that treats practitioners with respect—meaning zero data collection and zero notifications shouting for your attention.

How the Product Evolved:

Building a software studio at a slower, "human pace" while managing a chronic illness (ME) forces you to become hyper-intentional.

Ditching the Subscription: I originally planned a standard annual subscription tier. But as the studio's anti-rental philosophy solidified, that felt hypocritical. So I completely changed direction. The core app is entirely free, and additional functionality for established practitioners is unlocked via a single, small one-off payment. Buy it once, own it forever.

I will be hanging out in the comments section and I would love to hear your feedback, your critiques, or your own stories about fighting subscription fatigue!
Totally love it! Can it work on my Apple Watch?
Sounds calm , what's the revenue model?

items.title: Morsa Signals
items.name: Morsa Signals
items.summary: GTM and AI visibility workflows for developer tools
items.description: Morsa Signals gives developer-tool founders and GTM teams practical GTM and SEO/GEO workflows in one place. Find relevant developers for scaled outreach, identify potential first users and early adopters, audit how AI search systems understand your site, and get a first read on competitors worth tracking. Each workflow starts from your actual product and produces a focused, actionable result instead of a generic report or database.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I’m Sergei, co-founder at Morsa.


We built Morsa Signals around a recurring problem with developer tools: strong products often struggle to reach the right developers, explain their relevance, and become discoverable through search and AI systems.

Morsa Signals brings together four focused workflows:


🔎 Contact Search
Finds relevant developers for teams scaling outreach, explains why each person fits, and suggests a personalized opening angle.
https://signals.morsa.io/contact-search


🌱 First Users
Helps solo and early-stage devtool founders identify potential early adopters for their first outreach conversations.
https://signals.morsa.io/first-users


🤖 AI Visibility Audit
Reviews how clearly a devtool website communicates its product to search and AI systems, then generates a ready-to-use prompt for addressing identified gaps.
https://signals.morsa.io/audit


📡 Competitor Tracking
Provides a first read on relevant competitors and the public signals worth monitoring.
https://signals.morsa.io/competitor-tracking


Each workflow starts with the actual product, audience, and problem. The goal is a focused, actionable result rather than a generic report or database.


I’d especially value feedback from devtool founders and GTM teams: which problem is most urgent for you, and what would make you trust the result?
Cool idea. I see you are relying on GitHub data to find relevant developers. You could expand your list by including profiles from launch platforms like Product Hunt, Peerlist and Indie Hackers.

One additional thought behind Morsa Signals:

Growing a developer tool rarely comes down to one isolated problem. Some teams need their first users, others need better outreach data, clearer AI visibility, or a better understanding of their competitive space.

We brought these workflows together because they all start from the same context: the actual product, its audience, and the problem it solves.

If you’re building a developer tool, I’d be interested to know which workflow you would use first and what you would need to trust its results.

idea_items.need_line: 在梳理 AI 应用场景时，如何从组织架构、角色权限和子系统业务中快速提炼出完整需求边界，仍是主要痛点。
idea_items.status_line: 目前的做法是先判断产品是标准化还是定制化，再照组织架构确定角色、逐个访谈子系统业务，最后按角色权限和界面操作影响补全场景，基本停留在人工访谈加文档整理。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的方向是让访谈纪要、组织架构和既有系统字段能自动映射成角色—单据—流程—权限的依赖结构，并按标准化与定制化两条路径分别标出需求边界。

Now requires `slug`; optional `mapping: Dict[str, str]`. - `PipelineConfig`, `CreatePipelineConfigRequest`, `UpdatePipelineConfigRequest`: `definition` replaced by required `definitions: List[PipelineConfigDefinition]`. `slug` and `group` removed. `definition_hash` also removed from `PipelineConfig`. - `ListPipelineConfigsV1ObservabilityPipelineConfigsGetRequest`: `group` query parameter removed. **New required fields** - `chain_run_id: Nullable[str]` on all workflow and task event responses (`WorkflowExecution*`, `ActivityTask*`, `CustomTask*`, `WorkflowTask*`). - `last_heartbeat: datetime` on `DeploymentResponse`, `DeploymentDetailResponse`, `DeploymentWorkerResponse`. - `supports_mcp: bool` on `HTTPConnector` and `MCPConnector`. - `type` on `VoiceResponse`, `managed_indexes` on `Rag`. **Type changes** - `search_keys` values are now nullable on `WorkflowExecutionResponse`, `WorkflowExecutionTraceEventsResponse`, `WorkflowExecutionTraceOTelResponse`, `WorkflowExecutionTraceSummaryResponse`: `Dict[str, str]` -> `Dict[str, Nullable[str]]`. - `And` and `Or` are objects again (`type`, `matches`) after being removed in 2.10.0. They were union aliases of `FilterGroup | FilterCondition` in 2.9.x. **Deprecated** - `updated_at` on the deployment models now emits a DeprecationWarning. Use `last_heartbeat`. **Relaxed (non-breaking)** - `ListServiceAccountsV1ServiceAccountsGetRequest.workspace_id` is now optional. Publishing Completed
vendor_news_items.summary: Mistral 发布 Python SDK v2.10.1，基于 OpenAPI 新增 managedindexes 的 create、delete、get、list、search、update 等 8 个接口，并移除 JudgeDefinition 的 model、prompt 字段、将 PipelineConfig 的 definition 改为必填的定义列表等破坏性变更。
impact_points: Mistral AI 开放新 API / 工具后，开发者可以直接把上游能力接入现有工作流。
watch_items: 关注新 API / 工具是否附带调用限制、权限门槛或额外工程复杂度。

high_potential_items.title: Sylinko/Everywhere
high_potential_items.name: everywhere
high_potential_items.summary: On-screen aware AI assistant for your desktop. Uses current app context, multiple LLMs, and MCP tools to help you act across apps.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 读当前屏幕上下文，跨应用把事做完
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 做垂直场景助手时，可借鉴它把「当前屏幕内容」当成免输入的隐式上下文，再用 MCP 工具链把模型输出直接落到别的应用里，而不是停在对话框里。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版只做最小闭环：读取当前窗口文本作为上下文，接一个模型，挂一个 MCP 工具，让用户在当前应用里说一句指令就把结果写进目标应用。
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 桌面级屏幕感知 AI 助手，能结合当前应用上下文与 MCP 跨应用执行任务，最贴近 AI 工作流与产品化方向。

high_potential_items.title: browser-act/skills
high_potential_items.name: skills
high_potential_items.summary: Browser automation CLI built for AI agents. Break through anti-bot walls, hand off to humans across platforms when stuck. Parallel multi-task execution, independent multi-session operation, isolated multi-account browsing.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 反爬穿透、卡住可转人工的多账号浏览器 CLI
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把浏览器自动化封装成 agent 可直接调用的 CLI，并在反爬拦截、验证码等卡点处保留人工接管入口，这套「自动跑为主、人工只接手卡点」的分工方式值得做网页抓取与数据提取的 agent 产品借鉴。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版先让一个 agent 会话通过 CLI 打开目标网站并抓取数据，识别到反爬或验证失败时暂停并把当前页面交给人工操作，人工处理完由同一会话继续往下跑。
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 为 AI Agent 提供浏览器自动化与反爬、人机交接能力，偏底层工具，可支撑企业自动化但非直接产品方向。

high_potential_items.title: callstack/agent-device
high_potential_items.name: agent-device
high_potential_items.summary: Mobile app automation and verification for AI coding agents. CLI, MCP server, and typed Node.js API for iOS, Android, HarmonyOS, TV, web, macOS, and Linux.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 让 AI 编码代理亲手操作移动端做验证
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 值得借鉴的是把 CLI、MCP server 和类型化 Node.js API 打包成同一套设备操作层，让 AI 代理像调用函数一样启动模拟器、装包、点按并断言界面，这个接入形态可迁移到任何需要代理触碰真实设备或浏览器的验证场景。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版只打通一条链路：用 MCP server 暴露启动 iOS 模拟器、安装应用、点按输入、截图断言四类工具，让代理独立跑通一次登录 E2E 并回传失败截图。
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 面向 AI 编程代理的移动端自动化验证工具，属于 Agent 基础设施，但与雷达关注的直接应用场景匹配度一般。

interest_sections.title: 法律 AI 工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是法律 AI 的争论点已经从“能不能替代人审合同”下沉到审到什么颗粒度、依据能否被律师复核，而条文与判决公开这一数据条件正被当成可自建工作流的前提。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是通用模型加现成工具混用——有人直接拿 ChatGPT 类模型处理合同，有人上 Ironclad、律己 AI、幂律智能这类已有商业产品做审查和全生命周期管理，GitHub 上也出现用 LangChain Agent 接法律数据库 API 自建咨询、审查、文书生成的项目，讨论仍集中在“AI 能不能审得准”而非具体条款颗粒度。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把公开法律条文与裁判文书做成可检索底座，让模型对具体条款输出带引用出处、可逐条核对的判断结果，而不是只给一段笼统的修改建议。

interest_sections.title: AI 应用场景 / 数据
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，核心观察是B端需求梳理的耗时集中在多组织角色访谈与流程对齐，讨论还停在方法论拆解，没有对应的结构化沉淀手段。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前的做法是先判断产品是标准化还是定制化，再照组织架构确定角色、逐个访谈子系统业务，最后按角色权限和界面操作影响补全场景，基本停留在人工访谈加文档整理。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是让访谈纪要、组织架构和既有系统字段能自动映射成角色—单据—流程—权限的依赖结构，并按标准化与定制化两条路径分别标出需求边界。

interest_sections.title: 智能旅行助手
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是自由行行程规划仍依赖人工跨平台筛选攻略，而开源侧已出现用 Agent 技能串联调研与地图输出的雏形。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前讨论集中在按平台分级筛选攻略——专攻攻略的马蜂窝/穷游、作为种草社区的小红书/知乎/豆瓣、同质化严重的抖音，同时 GitHub 上有 trip-map-builder 用 Agent Skill 把规划、小红书调研和交互式地图串成流程。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把多源攻略的调研、交叉验证和地理信息整合成可编辑的按天行程草稿，并直接输出交互式地图路线，而不是再做一个攻略社区或平台推荐榜。

interest_sections.title: 教育 AI 辅导
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，核心是语文老师把备课视为最耗时环节、单节新课常需数小时以上，现有讨论仍以人工硬备和压力倾诉为主，尚未出现针对该链路的 AI 辅助方案。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 语文老师备一节新课常要数小时以上，最明确的需求是让教案撰写和课前预演从零硬备变成可快速修改的初稿

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前讨论中，老师仍靠提前多轮备课、上课前自己演习并接受备课不充分来硬扛，把耗时主要归因于语文学科特性和教案设计本身。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是面向语文新课备课链路，生成可核查的教案草稿与课前预演问答，让老师把时间花在判断和修改上。
